note: Family-run RV park on Hwy 49 about 5 miles north of Annapolis, in a meadow beside Big Creek: three rows of sites, the east row along a trail above the creek, with a pool (Memorial Day-Labor Day), fishing pond, petting zoo and walking trails. A flood on July 11, 2026 damaged the park; the owners say every site has reopened. --Claude
summary: Operator site + RoverPass engine (bookable, CRS): 63 FHU 30/50 A sites, 21 pull-throughs; closed Dec-Feb; regular rates dated June 2027 $49-57 (posted undated table $45-53; fall special $30-35). Passes the $50 gate narrowly at $49 weekday ($52 Sat); Google 4.6 (137). Short-stay park (online up to 10 nights). Flood 2026-07-11, reopened. Not waterfront stands; creek-row lead.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: Google 4.6 (137 reviews). Price: cheapest site EKKO fits $49 a night on a June 2027 weekday, $52 on a Saturday (RoverPass quotes, platform fee $3.50 per booking on top); the operator's undated table says $45-53 and a fall special runs August-November ($30 in Nov 2026). Under $50 on weekdays only - borderline; the reviews support keeping it. Presence: own website with phone 573-598-1064 and a claimed, bookable RoverPass listing.

IS $45 DATED: no. The rate page carries no date or year ('Rates are subject to changes at any time'); RoverPass's dated quotes now put the cheapest regular-season night at $49. Fees rewritten to $49-57 with the dates.

LONG-STAY TESTS: not long-stay in character. (1) nightly sites are the product: every RV rate is a nightly 'Short Term RV Site'; (2) posted nightly rates: yes; (3) online booking capped at 10 nights, initial booking max 1 week, longer stays by phone only; (4) no monthly/seasonal site rate offered (the only monthly price is $49 RV storage); (5) the operator leads with family camping, pool and events. Passes.

FLOOD: 'On July 11, 2026, a devastating flood washed through Big Creek RV Park ... all our campsites are open and ready for guests'; the pull-through sites have been resurfaced. Noted in the note with the date.
RIG RULES (EKKO passes): RVIA logo required on every RV; owners of RVs over 10 years old must call before booking (EKKO is a 2023).

WATERFRONT LEAD (stays 'not waterfront', unsure): the operator sells sites 102-123 as 'Creekfront' / 'ST Creek Site'. The August 2026 site map puts the Old Hwy 49 walking trail and a tree band between the east row and Big Creek, reached by a 'Creek Entrance' path; on leaf-off imagery the east-row pads at the south end are ~30-40 m from the creek's gravel bar through a band of trees, and the north end ~100 m. A trail plus a tree band is a buffer under the open-apron rule, and there is no creek-view value, so not waterfront stands. A summer photo from a 100-row site could earn creekside.
SITE COUNT: homepage '63 ... (21 are pull-throughs)'; the August 2026 map numbers 65 (101-123, 201-221, 302-321) and the rate page 102-123/201-221/301-321. Kept 63, the operator's stated figure.
PIN 37.4250,-90.6970 is at the office/entrance at the north end; the rows run ~350 m south, centring ~37.4233,-90.6970 (~190 m). Under 250 m - optional move.
